newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: TENNIS-IVANISEVIC STRETCHED BY WILD-CARD BELGIAN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-IVANISEVIC STRETCHED BY WILD-CARD BELGIAN.

text.p: Second seed Goran Ivanisevic needed three sets and seven match points to overcome wild-card entry Filip Dewulf of Belgium in the first round of the $800,000 CA Trophy on Tuesday.
Dewulf, winner last year, took the first set 6-4 but lost his service with a double fault in the second and the Croat squared the match 7-5.
Ivanisevic hammered down the aces in the third set for a break at 4-2, but Dewulf resisted stoutly before bowing out 6-2.
Stefan Edberg, still suffering from the influenza which forced him to drop out of last week's tournament in Lyon, France, had little trouble eliminating Slovakia's Jan Kroslak 6-4 6-2.
Edberg, playing his last year on the tour, clinched the first set with a break in the seventh game. Kroslak dropped serve twice at 1-0 and 5-2 in the second set to hand the Swede victory.

"I'm pretty much into taking every week at a time," said Edberg. "My dream would be to win one more tournament before I retire. But it's getting very difficult. I have been having too many bad days in the last two years."
Unseeded Michael Stich, who tore ankle ligaments in the tournament last year during a quarter-final against Todd Woodbridge, breezed past Hernan Gumy of Argentina 6-2 6-2.
Russian Andrei Medvedev eliminated Italian Andrea Gaudenzi, a last-minute substitute for back injury victim Cedric Pioline of France, 6-3 6-4.
